package.description: A reader that thinks: agentic reading for academic papers.

en-US.author: zhangzejing
en-US.description: A reader that thinks: agentic reading for academic papers.
en-US.longDescription:
ThinkReader is an agentic app for paper research. Your agents read alongside you and leave comments on the original PDF, so you can follow an idea back to its evidence without giving up control of what the paper really says. The knowledge you build together can support summaries, reports, mind maps, slides, and reproduction projects—all grounded in the source.

Why ThinkReader?
One kind of agentic paper reading turns papers into fast-food summaries; another floods the page with untraceable AI-generated information.
ThinkReader is neither: it keeps the original PDF, your judgment, and the agent's work in one place. It lets you open the paper, read it quickly but deeply, and turn what you learn into high-quality outputs. Only making the paper your own understanding can truly move your research forward.

How it works
A paper odyssey: you upload a paper to a Library; MinerU builds semantic and layout resources, while the original PDF always remains the reading surface. Then you, the paper canvas, and agents build understanding around the evidence together. That understanding can become a report, wiki, slides, mind map, or reproduction starting point—and always remains traceable to the paper.

Features
- Read in flow. Agent annotations stream onto the PDF canvas without interrupting your reading.
- Multi-agent collaboration. Give agents distinct roles, work together in a Channel, and carry the conversation across reading and writing.
- Intelligent layout. Read in one to three columns and arrange the page around your needs; agents understand the original layout, making paper-grounded conversation effortless.
- Read once, reuse everywhere. Carry everything you understand while reading into summaries, reports, slides, mind maps, and reproduction projects.
- Find what's next. Compile knowledge across papers into a research network and find the next question worth exploring.
en-US.name: ThinkReader
en-US.releaseNotes:
ThinkReader 0.9.70 正式版，支持 Windows x64 和 macOS Apple Silicon。
- 修复“只批注摘要”等限定范围任务被误报为全文未完成。
- 修复手动删除 default 后，同名重建的论文库无法打开。
- 图片、表格、公式和算法检测框复用区域批注的主题边界样式。
Windows 提供安装版、便携版和 ZIP，二进制未签名。Mac 要求 macOS 14+ / Apple Silicon，采用 ad-hoc 签名，未经过 Apple 公证，更新需手动安装。校验值见 SHA256SUMS.txt，测试结果和未验证范围见 validation.json。Windows 两项界面回归仍未通过，真实 MinerU 检查因 runner 缺少 Token 未执行，本次更新安装链路未重新验收。

ThinkReader 0.9.70 for Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon.
- Fix completion reporting for annotation tasks restricted to a section, such as the abstract.
- Fix opening a default Library recreated after its directory was manually removed.
- Use the area-annotation theme style for detected figure, table, equation and algorithm borders.
Windows binaries are unsigned. The Mac app requires macOS 14+ and Apple Silicon, uses ad-hoc signing, is not notarized, and requires manual updates. See SHA256SUMS.txt and validation.json. Two Windows UI regression checks remain unresolved. The Windows real MinerU check lacked a configured Token, and this version's update-installation flow has not been accepted.

zh-CN.description: 会思考的阅读器：面向学术论文的智能 Agent 阅读。
zh-CN.longDescription:
ThinkReader 是一款面向论文研究的智能体应用。智能体伴你一同阅读，并在 PDF 原文上留下批注，让你在始终掌控论文真实原意的前提下，循着观点溯源到背后的证据。你们共同构建的认知体系，可支撑起总结、报告、思维导图、演示文稿以及复现项目——一切皆有源可溯。

为什么选择 ThinkReader？
市面上的一类论文阅读智能体将论文变成了快餐式的摘要；另一类则让页面充斥着无法溯源的 AI 生成内容。
ThinkReader 与它们都不同：它将原始 PDF、你的判断以及智能体的工作融于一处。它让你打开论文，读得既快又深，并将所学转化为高质量的产出。唯有将论文内化为你自己的理解，才能真正推动研究向前迈进。

运作方式
一场论文探索之旅：你将论文上传至文献库（Library）；MinerU 构建语义与版面资源，而原始 PDF 始终作为阅读的主界面。随后，你、论文画布与智能体共同围绕证据构建理解。这些理解可以沉淀为报告、知识库（Wiki）、演示文稿、思维导图或代码复现的起点——且始终能够精确溯源至论文原文。

功能特性
- 心流阅读。智能体批注以流式形式呈现在 PDF 画布上，阅读思路不被打断。
- 多智能体协作。为智能体赋予不同角色，在同一频道（Channel）内协同作业，让对话贯穿阅读与写作全程。
- 智能排版。支持单栏到三栏阅读，根据需求随心布局页面；智能体能够理解原始排版，让基于论文的对话探讨轻而易举。
- 一次研读，多维复用。将阅读过程中所理解的一切，直接转化为总结、报告、演示文稿、思维导图和复现项目。
- 探寻前沿。将跨论文的知识汇聚成研究网络，发掘下一个值得探索的科学问题。
